name: NEXORA_INT_FullStack_Marketing_Platform_Web_App
description: NEXORA Marketing & Network Management Platform - Full Stack TypeScript

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=client && npm install --workspace=server && npm install --workspace=shared
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.build:force: npx --yes typescript -p shared/tsconfig.json && npx --yes typescript -p server/tsconfig.json && npm run build -w client
